brief.en: Plant multiple times on the same spot to multiply damage
brief.zh: 多次重叠种植提高攻击力

description.en: Pea Pods can be planted in the same space for up to 5 times the destruction.
description.zh: 在同一格种植豌豆荚，能让他们的攻击力提升到至多 5 倍。

chat.en: Having studied Quantum Spatial Mechanics in Clown College, Pea Pod has been amusing families of all ages.
chat.zh: 自从毕业于职业小丑学院的空间量子力学专业，豌豆荚就一直在取悦家里的老小。

text.en: increases rate of fire with multiple plantings
text.zh: 多次种植，提高单次发射豌豆数量
